Learning progress is an educational guide, not a diagnostic assessment.
Kid Genius World’s early-access learning runs without a child account. Nicknames, chosen grade levels and learning attempts are saved in your browser on this device.

Directions and stories use your browser’s built-in speaking voice. Kid Genius World does not call a paid voice API. A parent can enable optional microphone practice. It starts only after the learner presses the microphone button and the browser grants access. Speech recognition is allowed only on-device when supported; otherwise listening and self-check practice remain available. Kid Genius World does not store or upload audio or recognized transcripts.

A parent can save encrypted family progress to Cloudflare and restore it with a private family code. The code contains an access token and a separate encryption key. The key is not sent to the server. Backups include nicknames, levels, learning evidence and saved writing. A save renews the backup for 30 days; expired backups are removed during daily cleanup. Anyone with the complete code can open the backup, and there is no email recovery. You can delete the cloud backup from the parent space. Device progress is kept separately.

Parents sign in through Firebase Authentication. Our Firebase billing service verifies membership with Stripe. Card details stay with Stripe. Device progress is separated by parent account. Optional encrypted backups move progress between devices.

You can turn spoken encouragement off, export progress, and use a nickname instead of a real name. Removing this site’s stored browser data removes device progress. Parent account deletion will remove server account and progress records when accounts are enabled.
This early-access notice describes the implemented data flows. Kid Genius World is operated by CrateShip Studios. Contact crateshipstudios@gmail.com for account, billing or data support.

Un can mean the opposite. Re can mean again. Read the base word, then add the prefix meaning.
Ful means having, less means without, and ness names a state or quality.

Grade 1 uses counting, addition and subtraction; Grade 2 adds equal groups and deeper place value; Grade 3 adds formal multiplication, division, fractions, area and perimeter. Reading moves from sounds and word patterns into word parts, fluent reading and text evidence.
